title: Towards a Principled Muon under $μ\mathsf{P}$: Ensuring Spectral Conditions throughout Training
summary: The $μ$-parameterization ($μ$P) provides a principled foundation for large language model (LLM) training by prescribing width-independent learning dynamics, which in turn enables predictable scaling behavior and robust hyperparameter transfer across model sizes. A central requirement of $μ$P is the satisfaction of certain spectral conditions on weight matrices, which ensure consistent feature learning and optimization behavior as model width grows.
